name: Mistral AI API token pricing (serverless, per million tokens, 2026-10-04 list price)
region: Mistral cloud (EU/US); no regional GPU SKU to price
price_basis: USD per MILLION TOKENS, LIST PRICE, observed 2026-10-04. The page's own worked example: 'Mistral Large costs $0.5 /M tokens in and $1.5 /M tokens out' - price_usd = Mistral Large input. Structural rules stated on the page: most models are priced per million tokens with input and output counted SEPARATELY; Batch processing reduces the price by 50%; cached input tokens reduce input cost by up to 90%. Some APIs are priced differently - OCR per 1,000 pages, speech models per minute, tool APIs per call. Seat plans carry API credits ($10/mo, $14.99, $24.99, $30, $50 tiers).
notes: LOW-CONFIDENCE RECORD BY CONSTRUCTION, AND THE REASON IS IN THE BASIS FIELD: Mistral's public page states the SHAPE of its pricing (per million tokens, separate input/output, batch at 50% off, cached input up to 90% off) and gives exactly ONE numeric example (Mistral Large $0.50 in / $1.50 out), but does not publish a per-model rate card in the extracted text. So only the Mistral Large figure here is a transcribed number; everything else is the vendor's stated pricing RULE, not a price. Mistral is also the only provider in this set whose headline token rates are bundled into subscription seats with included API credits, which means the effective per-token cost depends on whether you exhaust the credits - a structural difference from pure pay-as-you-go that a reader comparing $/Mtok across this set must account for. Verified students get Mistral Pro at $5.99/month. No GPU hourly rate published.
